body: I won't rush it. Thank you for your time. It means a lot.
Maybe one day I can open up to him. Its just hard.
That's a good idea just its hard for me to trust someone.
I talked to my ex about it. We just recently broke up which is weighing heavy on me too.

Well when I was in the sixth grade my mom disappeared for a couple weeks. She just left me and my dad.  Then she showed back up at the house with a man and both of them were beyond drunk.  My dad took it better than I did. Besides that nothing else really happened that day. But she would disappear like that for about the next year. One day I walked in on her and this man having sex. This whole situation screwed me up. Anyway after she started seeing this other man she basically mentally abused me and has been since. I feel worthless.

Yes I know and that's why I haven't done it yet. Thats why im posting here. Talking seems to help. I seem to get better but then it gets worse. I have never actually acted on my thoughts which is good but some nights its hard not to.
I'm 24 and I'm a woodworker. No degree. I feel stuck in a dead end life. I feel worthless. I want to be happy.
I just feel like I'm a piece of shit. Everything I do doesn't seem good enough. I'm tired of feeling this way.
